description: Cross-device workspace for sharing screens, apps, files, clipboard, input, calls, and notifications across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
pre_install: if ($null -eq $payload) { throw 'TwinDesk application payload archive was not found.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'TwinDesk.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'TwinDesk.exe was not found after extracting the nested application archive.' }
notes: This manifest extracts the verified NSIS application payload; it does not run the vendor installer or its system-wide installer hooks.

The upstream Windows installer adds inbound Windows Firewall rules, changes the WebClient FileSizeLimitInBytes registry value, and adds a certificate to the TrustedPeople store. These actions are intentionally not run by Scoop; features that depend on them may require manual setup.
TwinDesk stores settings and pairing data under %APPDATA%\MacShare, outside the Scoop directory. Scoop uninstall does not remove this user data.
